operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case quoted table names ("actor","address",...) plus unquoted film_text; identifiers must be double-quoted with original case.
DATETIME columns store TEXT like '2006-02-15 04:34:33.0' (trailing .0); declared DATETIME dispatches to Date fuzzer (first element not int-parsable).
film.release_year is TEXT holding '2006' (single distinct) -> String fuzzer, not Number; text-stored year.
film.original_language_id is 100% NULL, distinct 0 -> Number sampler with empty elements (p:=1, fresh draws).
staff.picture BLOB stored as text hex '0x3F504E47...' with 50% NULL -> String fuzzer on blob.
store.manager_staff_id is UNIQUE FK to staff; staff.store_id FK back to store -> store<->staff cycle; process_order must break it deterministically.
Self-referential-ish cycle: store->staff->store and staff->address, store->address; address->city->country chain.
film_actor and film_category have composite PKs (actor_id,film_id)/(film_id,category_id) -> composite-PK member max_l0=30.
rental has UNIQUE(rental_date,inventory_id,customer_id) multi-column unique; drop_unique_duplicates only handles single-column uniques.
payment.rental_id nullable FK to rental with ON DELETE SET NULL; 5 rows NULL (distinct 16044 < 16049).
address2/postal_code/phone have empty-string '' values (not NULL) with low distinct; String fuzzer will treat '' as element.
Tables small (max 16049 rows) so full read; no huge-table sampling needed here.
operator_ts_expectations: Date fuzzer on all DATETIME cols: template from '2006-02-15 04:34:33.0' -> likely %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f style; range 2005-2006, fresh dates formatted same.
last_update columns have distinct=1 -> Date range collapses to <2 distinct -> full 1800-2100 range, producing implausible far-future/past dates (FN driver).
String fuzzer on names/titles/emails: random CHARSET strings + contamination, so 'MARY.SMITH@sakilacustomer.org' style emails become garbage (FN on email LIKE/format queries).
Number fuzzer on INTEGER PKs: fresh uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale] then +-1/+-2 perturbation -> huge/negative ids, implausible for joins/range filters (FN).
Number on REAL rental_rate/amount/replacement_cost: uniform over [-10^4,10^4] (scale from no args -> default) -> implausible money values (FN on amount<X).
FK columns drawn from parent's final values with replacement -> many duplicate child FKs, ties present; but parent PK filtering may shrink parent so FK NULLs appear.
active/store_id/staff_id low-cardinality INTEGER get random ints, losing the 0/1 or 1/2 domain (FN on active=1).
rating/special_features/category.name/language.name are ENUM-like TEXT but String fuzzer emits random strings -> FN on rating='PG' or category name filters.
Composite PK tables (film_actor,film_category) get PK-duplicate rows dropped, but FK draws with replacement create heavy duplication before filtering -> possible FP on COUNT DISTINCT vs COUNT.
Empty-string vs NULL distinction in address2/postal_code/phone likely lost (String fuzzer rarely emits ''), FP/FN on IS NULL / ='' queries.
release_year TEXT '2006' -> String fuzzer adds '2007'/'2005' neighbors and random strings; queries filtering release_year='2006' may still match via element reuse.
